mission: Build a fractal Google Maps of law for Swiss Federal Supreme Court case law from 2000 onward plus user-imported corpora, beating simple semantic-map baselines in legal usefulness.

corpus.question: Scale the canonical TF-2000+ acquisition/normalization pipeline from current 1,577 decisions (1000 slice + 250 yearly core) to full coverage (2000-2024). Implement robust user corpus import with schema validation and map artifact persistence.

legal-distance.question: PIVOT from unsupervised signal ablation (COMPLETED) to next phase: (1) Scale test: validate legal_cited_decisions_only and hybrid modes on full TF 2000+ corpus; (2) Legal embeddings: test Isaacus/Legal-BERT for multilingual invariance of legal signals; (3) Citation role modeling: distinguish/follow/overrule roles vs simple citation lists; (4) Jurist pairwise evaluation of hybrid map modes vs baseline; (5) Benchmark refinement: replace duplicate/non-discriminating benchmarks with jurist-usefulness proxies.

fractal-map.question: Productize the validated multi-resolution hierarchical Leiden map (nesting=1.0, purity=0.9634, zoom_coherence +7.68%): expose resolution ladder, cluster metadata, legal coherence at each zoom level in product; integrate as default map structure with legal-distance selectable modes.

evaluation.question: Extend evaluation to v2: jurist usability studies, Jurivoc descriptor integration, scale benchmarks for full corpus, adversarial tests for representation stability under corpus growth and cross-language transfer. Fix non-determinism with global seed.

product.question: Complete vertical slice integration: persist user-imported map artifacts, add map export, integrate legal-distance signals (legal_cited_decisions_only, hybrid α=0.3, hybrid α=0.5, legal_issues_outcomes) as selectable map modes alongside debiased_citation_blended default, harden corpus-to-map pipeline for TF base map plus user imports.

director_note: Evidence synthesis from ACCEPTED lane runs: (1) Legal-distance v3 COMPLETE — unsupervised signal ablation answered: debiased_citation_blended (n_pca=1, alpha=0.7) and legal_cited_decisions_only both achieve 14/14 PASS; hybrids α=0.3/0.5 achieve 13/14 PASS, excel at legal classification (branch_knn 0.96, tf_metadata 0.97) but fail adversarial_falsification; legal signals degrade multilingual invariance. Recommendation: keep baseline default, expose 4 selectable map modes. Lane pivots to scale/embeddings/roles/jurist-eval. (2) Fractal-map VALIDATED (REPRODUCED): hierarchical Leiden nesting=1.0, purity=0.9634, zoom_coherence 39.6% improvement rate, 6 product integration artifacts created. Ready for product exposure. (3) Evaluation v1 COMPLETE (REPRODUCED): 13/14 PASS, 1 marginal boilerplate FAIL fixed by global seed; baseline frozen. v2 targets jurist studies, Jurivoc, scale. (4) Product VALIDATED: 11/11 product tests PASS, user import + k-NN positioning + export working. (5) Corpus VALIDATED: 1,577 schema-valid decisions, Parquet 784.7MB, statute extractor 85 laws. Needs full 2000-2024 scale. (6) Frontier team frontier_metric_learning_jurivoc RUN (charter v1) pursues SUPERVISED metric learning on Jurivoc/TF weak labels — complementary independent path to legal-distance unsupervised ablation. Dual-track legal-signal enrichment proceeding.
